title: GOESB Hardware Catalog Entry
description: A curated, git-reviewed CPU/GPU catalog entry a runner user can assert as the real hardware behind a benchmark result, replacing the OS-probed (and under virtualization, unrecoverable) raw model string.

id.description: Globally unique, immutable hardware id, e.g. 'intel-xeon-e3-1240-v6'.

display_name.description: Human-readable name, e.g. 'Intel Xeon E3-1240 v6'.

category.description: Which compute path a result on this hardware actually exercises — not a strict silicon taxonomy. A full SoC (e.g. a Jetson module) is 'gpu' if benchmarks on it run via CUDA, 'cpu' if they run on its ARM cores; a dedicated add-in inference card (Hailo, Coral) that isn't a CPU or GPU at all is 'accelerator'. See hardware/README.md.

ram_gb.description: System RAM, for cpu/other boards that ship in more than one RAM configuration (e.g. a 4GB vs 8GB SKU of the same board) — a separate catalog entry per real configuration, not a range.

tops.description: Peak int8 TOPS, for accelerator-category entries (Hailo, Coral, and similar dedicated inference cards) — their headline comparison spec, same role vram_gb plays for gpu.
